description: This file defines the 'Inflights' data structure and related methods for managing in-flight MsgApp messages in a Raft implementation, including buffer management, adding messages, freeing acknowledged messages, and checking capacity.

classes.name: Inflights
classes.description: A structure to manage in-flight MsgApp messages, limiting their number and total byte size.

methods.name: NewInflights
methods.description: Initializes a new Inflights instance with specified size and maxBytes limits.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Inflights instance.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new in-flight message with specified index and byte size.

methods.name: grow
methods.description: Doubles the size of the buffer when needed, up to the maximum size.

methods.name: FreeLE
methods.description: Frees in-flight messages with index less than or equal to the specified 'to' value.

methods.name: Full
methods.description: Checks if the inflight buffer is full and cannot accept more messages.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the current number of in-flight messages.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the inflight buffer, clearing all messages.
